steps.instruction: Read the request, source material and curriculum context. Freeze audience, outcomes, required languages, claims, citations, optional image intent, tracks and unchanged commands before producing an edition. Ask for any fact essential to correctness.

reads.when: when curriculum or style context is declared

calls.purpose: Read declared source and context files.
Close one named public-source gap without replacing supplied authority.
calls.when: when a factual gap requires current public evidence

calls.purpose: Persist the brief before any edition is written.

steps.instruction: Create every declared language edition from the frozen brief. Create each requested executable track without changing its contract. If an image is requested, generate only the brief's visual claim. For extend or revise, pass the actual selected baseline plus all preserve/change instructions; never substitute unrelated art or conversation memory.

reads.when: when context.visual mode is extend or revise

writes.when: for each edition, track, prompt or accepted image

calls.purpose: Write editions, tracks, prompt and package manifest inside the request artifact scope.
Generate or revise the requested educational image using the actual bound reference image.
calls.when: only when the frozen brief requires an image

produces: Declared editions, tracks and optional image assets.

steps.instruction: Run each declared build and executable check unchanged and record raw command, exit code and output. Inspect actual image pixels when present. Give concrete defects, delete rejected image deliverables, retain concise rejection metadata, and repair only the affected artifact before rerunning dependent checks.

calls.purpose: Run only the build and check commands frozen in the brief.
Inspect actual accepted candidate pixels beside the baseline when applicable.
Persist execution evidence and targeted artifact repairs; remove rejected image deliverables.

produces: Execution evidence and assessed content artifacts.

steps.instruction: Dispatch a fresh artifact-only review without the producer rationale. Persist findings and reassess after targeted repair. Write and validate the response only when the independent review and all criteria accept the artifacts.

writes.when: after acceptance or a terminal stop

calls.purpose: Give a separate reviewer only the frozen brief and produced artifacts, withholding the producer rationale.
Read the returned independent review and referenced artifacts.
Persist review evidence and response metadata.
Validate the compiled operator request and response.
